example.title: Spaulding Manufacturing Company building, 4th Ave. & Spring St. (NRHP)

brief: Plain, heavy two-storey red-brick block (a former carriage works office/showroom) on a raised basement: evenly spaced tall segmental windows with stone lintels and sills, a stone water table, a band of basement grilles, and a deep corbelled and dentilled brick cornice. Currently mothballed during conversion: windows boarded with plywood and orange panels, a chain-link construction fence and a skid-steer on the gravel lot, a round-arched side door.
